newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Corpus Christi takes FCC unit down.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Corpus Christi takes FCC unit down.

text.p: Coastal Corp took down a fluid catalytic cracker (FCC) at its 95,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) refinery in Corpus Christi, Texas after the unit emited carbon monoxide and thick black smoke, local environmental regulators said Friday.
Coastal reported that it was "curtailing operations at the FCC unit to analyze what the problem is," said a spokesman for the Texas Natural Resource Conservation Commission in Austin.
Gulf Coast traders earlier noted that Coastal has been offering to resell a cargo of Colombian Vasconia crude, prompting speculation about problems at the refinery.
The TNRCC reported that the unit emited carbon monoxide twice on Feb 12, and exceeded the environmental limit for smoke.
A spokesman for Coastal declined to comment.
